content: Ndǝr Hyal Kǝra YahwanaNdǝr Baɓǝtizǝma Tǝtǝlna

Wu fa nǝ kumo apǝ tǝfu wu tǝlkur nǝ Kayisaru Tiberiyasu, Buntusu Bilatusu ca ngǝ gwamna nǝr Yahudi, Hirudusu tsu ca ngǝ tǝl nǝr Galili, Fǝlipǝu zamǝ nyi ca ngǝ tǝl nǝr ˈyiˈyir Ituriya ǝnga Tarakunitusu, Lisaniyasu tsu tǝl Abilinisu.
Anasu ǝnga Kayafasu nanda ngǝ pubu dǝdǝgalˈyar. Wu pǝci ta tsu ngǝ ndǝr Hyal shili anǝ Yahwana zǝr Zakariya a gwar tagǝ mashi.

Kǝ Yahwana zǝwuya patǝkura ˈyiˈyi kǝra ar dza dǝl Urdǝnu. Ja vǝr tǝtǝlna ndǝr Hyal nǝ tubi anǝ nji, ja vǝr na, “Sha mau a shili wu lagu Hyal aga hya uya baɓǝtizǝma, Hyal tsu ju sa tǝfǝbiya hyi bikǝr hyi.”
Ənggǝra nabi Əshaya tsǝfǝri wu lǝkakaɗǝ nǝ Hyal abǝr,

content.text: ji na, “Ɗahǝ a vǝr ngga a gwar tagǝu, ja vǝr na,
hya mǝliya lagu tataˈyi pir wu mwa nyi.
kalar mǝ ǝnga gar nja hǝya a gya.
lagu didiɗiˈyar tsu nju mǝliya mǝnahǝu.
Ənga patǝr ndapi wu nda lari mbǝɗǝ nǝ Hyal.’”

content: Kǝ dlamir nji maˈyi a ndǝra Yahwana aga nda uya baɓǝtizǝma ara ja. Kǝ Yahwana nar nda, “Nahyi wazha mǝtsapa! Wa ngǝ kughiya hyi, aga hya hwi sara ara numa nǝ huɗǝ ndzǝndzǝ Hyal kǝra a vǝr shili ka?

Hya mǝl thlǝr kǝra mǝnahǝu wu nggyabiyar hyi kǝra wu cabiya abǝr a tubir hyi. A sara hya fiya wu ɗǝfuwa hyi tsu, abǝr, ‘Ibrahimu ngǝ dǝrˈya.’ Yu na anǝ hyi, abǝr Hyal aˈyi ja ǝnga dǝnama nǝ shabiya tsǝkaˈyar kau, aga wazha anǝ Ibrahimu.
A fiyar nji hira kǝm ar nggyilanga wu. Kalar wu kǝra gǝra pǝ wazha mǝnahǝu, nju nda gǝmna nyi, ba nja vakuwa a gwu uˈu.”
Kǝ nji kǝ yiwa nyi, “Mi nga ˈya kyaga mǝla?”
Yahwana shaɗǝwa nda, ji na, “Abǝr kalar ndǝra ǝnga lǝgutǝ mǝthlǝu, ja nǝ nyi pathlǝu anǝ ndǝra gǝra ǝni, kalar ndǝra ǝnga sǝr sǝm tsu ja mǝliya abangau.”
Njir tsǝm budǝ tsu ndǝ shili aga ja mǝliya nda baɓǝtizǝma, ndǝ yiwa nyi, ndǝ na, “Malǝmǝ, mi nga ˈya mǝla?”
Əngwar ja anǝ nda, “A sara hya dlǝwu a ndiya sǝra nji na hya tsǝm mai.”

Abangǝ tsu ngǝ alenyi sojaˈyar yiwa nyi, “Kar naˈya tsu, mi nga ˈya mǝla?” Kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “A sara hya canggǝr nyi anǝ nji aga nda nǝ hyi gǝnna ǝnga dǝnama mai, a sara hya thla fati ar kǝra nji mai, hya mbiya ɗǝfu ǝnga sǝra nji kina hyi ǝni.”
Nji patǝ a vǝr sǝkǝ shilir Kǝrsiti, ndǝ lari Yahwana kǝ ndǝ dzǝguya ɗǝnga wu ɗǝfuwa nda tara Yahwana ngǝ Kǝrsiti kau.
Kǝ Yahwana shaɗǝwa nda patǝu, “Nayau, ya vǝr mǝl baɓǝtizǝma anǝ hyi ǝnga ˈyimi. Ama vanyi ndǝra ndiya ɗa ǝnga dǝnama a vǝr shili, kǝra alaga sǝr mba ɓiɓi
nyi nayi aˈyi ɗa tsa aga ya pǝlna mai. Ju sa mǝliya hyi baɓǝtizǝma ǝnga Mambǝl Cicau ba ǝnga uˈu.
Cala pi nyi wu tsa ja nga nyi, ju pina uhi ba ja batǝna lar nyi ba ja dzǝgwa faˈana uhi a su tsam. Kofu ǝnga cacangǝ ba ja nggyina nda ǝnga uˈu kǝra gǝra tau.”
Ənga ɗahǝ pamǝpamǝ gangǝu ngǝ Yahwana tǝtǝlna ndǝshigu mǝsahǝ anǝ nji.
Ama ǝnggǝra Yahwana kughiya kughi anǝ gwamna Hirudusu kǝra hǝri Hirudiyasu mala zamǝ nyi Fǝlipǝu ǝnga patǝkura alenyi sǝ ɗǝmwaˈyi kǝra ji mǝliya.
Kǝ Hirudusu ɓǝra cakǝri ɗǝmwaˈyikur nyi ba ji fuwa Yahwana wu fursǝna.
Nji Mǝliya Nyi Baɓǝtizǝma Anǝ Yesu
Ayukuɗa ji kuɗǝna mǝl baɓǝtizǝma anǝ nji patǝu, ba ji mǝliya nyi anǝ Yesu tsu, ǝnggǝra Yesu a vǝr ndǝr ǝnga Hyal ba dǝmǝlmǝ pahau,
kǝ Mambǝl Cici shida ar kǝra ja a papa mbǝthla. Kǝ ɗahǝ sara a dǝmǝlmǝ na, “Nagǝ ngǝ zǝr ɗa, yu yiwu ngau, huɗa yi pipida ǝnga gau.”
Culi Kǝra Yesu Biya Sara Gwa
Ar pǝcira Yesu dzǝguya thlǝr nyi nǝ highiɓau, a tǝkǝr ja fa makǝr kumunyi wu duniya. Nji hǝri nyi abǝr naja zǝr Yusufu kǝra zǝr Hali.
Hali zǝr Matata, Matata zǝr Lawi, Lawi zǝr Melci, Melci zǝr Yonna, Yonna zǝr Yusufu,
Yusufu zǝr Matatiyasu Matatiyasu zǝr Amosu, Amosu zǝr Nahumu, Nahumu zǝr Azaliya, Azaliya zǝr Nagayi,
Nagayi zǝr Maata, Maata zǝr Matatiyasu Matatiyasu zǝr Saminu, Saminu zǝr Joseku, Joseku zǝr Yahuda,
Yahuda zǝr Yuwana, Yuwana zǝr Resa, Resa zǝr Zarubabelu, Zarubabelu zǝr Shaltiyalu, Shaltiyalu zǝr Neri,
Neri zǝr Melci, Melci zǝr Adi, Adi zǝr Kusam, Kusam zǝr Elmoda, Elmoda zǝr Eri,
Eri zǝr Jashuwa, Jashuwa zǝr Elezar, Elezar zǝr Jarimu, Jarimu zǝr Matata, Matata zǝr Lawi,
Lawi zǝr Simiyanu, Simiyanu zǝr Yahuda, Yahuda zǝr Yusufu, Yusufu zǝr, Janamu, Janamu zǝr Eliyakimu,
Eliyakimu zǝr Meliya, Meliya zǝr Meyinna, Meyinna zǝr Matathla, Matathla zǝr Nathlanu, Nathlanu zǝr Dawuda,
Dawuda zǝr Jesi, Jesi zǝr Obida, Obida zǝr Buˈaza, Buˈaza zǝr Salmonu, Salmonu zǝr Nashanu,
Nashanu zǝr Aminadaɓǝu, Aminadaɓǝu zǝr Aramu, Aramu zǝr Hesaruna, Hesaruna zǝr Parisu, Parisu zǝr Yahuda,
Yahuda zǝr Yakubu, Yakubu zǝr Ishaku, Ishaku zǝr Ibrahimu, Ibrahimu zǝr Tera, Tera zǝr Nahoru,
Nahoru zǝr Seragu, Seragu zǝr Riyu, Riyu zǝr Pelegǝ, Pelegǝ zǝr Eberu, Eberu zǝr Shila,
Shila zǝr Kayinanu, Kayinanu zǝr Arfashadu, Arfashadu zǝr Shemu, Shemu zǝr Nǝhu, Nǝhu zǝr Lameku,
Lameku zǝr Metusǝla, Metusǝla zǝr Enoku, Enoku zǝr Jaredu, Jaredu zǝr Mahalalelu, Mahalalelu zǝr Kenanu,
Kenanu zǝr Enoshu, Enoshu zǝr Shitu, Shitu zǝr Adamu, Adamu zǝr Hyal.

footnotes.text: Wu nggyabiya njir Yahudiya ma mǝthlǝpi shili wu ki, mafa alaga ndǝra ndiya ǝnga didiɗi wu ki kǝ ja zǝɗǝna ɓiɓi nyi ja dzǝgwa cina nyi hya ja.
